# cdfi-superpowers

> An AI skill layer over Jay Patel's published CDFI Python portfolio (PyPI user
> thejaypatel1511; GitHub Jaypatel1511). No new analytical code — skills that pip-install and call
> already-published, independently versioned packages, so an AI answers CDFI
> questions from audited tooling instead of hallucinating. Grounds NMTC
> eligibility, bank-CDFI peer benchmarking, descriptive HMDA analysis, IC credit
> memo generation, and fair-lending disparity screening.

Guiding rules for any AI using these skills: if a tool errors, report the error
(never estimate NMTC eligibility from general knowledge); render NaN/None/N-A as
N/A (never fabricate a number); hmda-analysis is descriptive only (no
fair-lending inference, no CRA performance interpretation) — inferential
fair-lending work is fair-lending-screening's, and its results are screening
signals, never findings of discrimination; credit-memo structures the user's
deal inputs and never invents a figure.

## Skills

- [nmtc-eligibility](.agents/skills/nmtc-eligibility/SKILL.md): Is an address/tract NMTC eligible? Distress tier, LIC status, project feasibility. Backed by nmtc-mapper >=0.6.1 + nmtc-screener 0.1.0.
- [cdfi-peer-benchmark](.agents/skills/cdfi-peer-benchmark/SKILL.md): Benchmark a bank CDFI against FDIC peers (NIM, ROAA, ROAE, efficiency, Tier 1, NPL). Bank CDFIs only. Backed by cdfi-benchmark >=0.3.0.
- [hmda-analysis](.agents/skills/hmda-analysis/SKILL.md): Pull HMDA LAR data and produce descriptive cuts + a CRA-proxy income distribution. Descriptive only. Backed by hmda-analyzer >=0.6.0 (0.6.0 itself needs Python >=3.11; 0.6.1 relaxed that to >=3.9).
- [credit-memo](.agents/skills/credit-memo/SKILL.md): Generate structured IC credit memos from deal inputs (CDFI loans, NMTC, equity, grants, guarantees) — collects deal data, builds the package's data classes, renders Markdown or Word. Every number is the user's; the package computes only Total Jobs, Cost per Job, a revenue-trend sentence, and three NMTC derived amounts. Backed by credit-memo >=0.2.2 (import: creditmemo).
- [fair-lending-screening](.agents/skills/fair-lending-screening/SKILL.md): Adjusted denial-disparity screening on public HMDA data — logistic regression with FFIEC-standard controls (income, loan amount, LTV, DTI, property value, MSA fixed effects), reporting an odds ratio with 95% CI and p-value. The inferential counterpart to hmda-analysis; results are screening signals, not findings of discrimination. Alpha status, race only, methodology not externally reviewed. Backed by fair-lending-screener >=0.2.2 (import: fair_lending_screener; 0.1.1 is yanked).

## References

- [cdfi-industry-primer](references/cdfi-industry-primer.md): Plain-language orientation — NMTC, LIHTC, CRA, HMDA, BEA, CMF; CDFI Fund, CDEs, QALICBs, QEIs.
- [data-source-map](references/data-source-map.md): Which host backs what, which are cloud-blocked, and the honest-UA convention.
- [package-index](references/package-index.md): All 22 portfolio packages — current non-yanked version (CI-checked against live PyPI on every run), dist/repo/import names, one-line purpose, and which packages have withdrawn releases. **Read this before installing any of them; four carry yanked releases.**
- [caveats-and-limits](references/caveats-and-limits.md): What the plugin deliberately does NOT do — fair-lending *findings* (screening only, and never from hmda-analysis), CRA ratings, credit-union benchmarking, pre-2018 TLR.
